title: Best Alternative to POI Business Interiors (Ontario)
meta_description: Honest comparison of POI Business Interiors and a multi-line furniture dealer for Ontario buyers: which model fits your project, with real products.
author: Steve Katz
excerpt: POI Business Interiors is a full-service interiors firm built for building-scale projects. For Ontario buyers who need commercial furniture planned, delivered, and installed without a building program, a multi-line dealer is often the better-fit alternative. An honest, public-information comparison of the two models, with real products and the shared OECM path.
faq_items: Is Brant Business Interiors a direct alternative to POI Business Interiors?||For furniture, design, delivery, and installation, yes. POI's public model is a full-service interiors firm that also handles audiovisual technology, facility management, planning, and relocations for large projects, anchored to a premium manufacturer line. Brant Business Interiors is a multi-line commercial furniture dealer. If your project is a building program, POI's breadth fits; if your project is commercial furniture planned and installed across Ontario, a furniture dealer is the better-matched alternative.

What is the difference between a full-service interiors firm and a furniture dealer?||A full-service interiors firm bundles furniture with trades such as construction, audiovisual, and flooring and coordinates them as one program, which suits large fit-outs. A furniture dealer's core business is commercial furniture: it carries multiple manufacturers, plans the layout, quotes the whole order, and delivers, installs, and services it. You can get full design and install support from a dealer without commissioning a multi-trade project.

Can a multi-line dealer match the product quality of a premium-brand firm?||Yes, because a multi-line dealer carries commercial-grade lines tested to the same standards. Canadian manufacturers such as Global Furniture Group and Offices to Go build products certified to ANSI/BIFMA and GREENGUARD, and a dealer can mix those lines to your budget and spec rather than fitting every need to one premium brand. Quality comes from the commercial rating and the right product choice, not from a single brand label.

Can Ontario public-sector buyers use OECM with either supplier?||Yes. Both POI Business Interiors and Brant Business Interiors are OECM supplier partners, so eligible Ontario broader-public-sector organizations can purchase eligible furniture without running a separate competitive process through either. For institutional buyers the OECM path is therefore not the deciding factor; the deciding factor is which model fits your project. Brant Business Interiors is registered under our parent legal entity, Brant Basics, as an authorized OECM Supplier Partner under Agreement 2025-470.

Do I have to be a large organization to work with Brant Business Interiors?||No. Because our core business is furniture rather than enterprise building programs, there is no project minimum. A ten-person office and a hospital department are served the same way: a design layout, a single quote across the right manufacturers, delivery, and professional installation across Ontario. Call us and we will scope it to what you actually need.
